**What's the problem**

What were you trying to do when you wished ADHDev did this thing? Concrete situation > abstract wish.

**What would solve it**

How you imagine it working. Sketch UI if helpful. Not committing the maintainers to that exact shape — the situation is what matters.

**Alternatives you considered**

What you do today instead, or other tools you've used that do this.

**How important is this to you**

- [ ] Nice to have
- [ ] I work around it daily
- [ ] I'd stop using ADHDev without it
